verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a commerce/POS SaaS that holds customer and order data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents retention settings, data deletion, or customer-data erasure in Shopify POS. Order cancellation and voided payments are adjacent transaction features, and extension storage persistence is a developer building block; neither counts as retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
